question: How should a track's header open the picked cut into its two clips?
context: The transition walkthrough mock opens a cut into its two clips from a chevron on the V1 track label. In the app that header already has an arrow that opens the track keyed-value lanes, so the mock chevron cannot simply take its place. Expand the Cut already works from the cut right-click, Clip > Expand the Cut and Option E.

options.label: A second chevron while a cut is picked
options.summary: With a cut picked on a track, a small down chevron appears on that track header beside its name. Click it and the cut opens into its A and B rows; click again and they close. The arrow that opens keyed values stays where it is.
pros: Exactly where the mock puts it
The key-lanes arrow keeps its one job
cons: Two arrows on one header while a cut is picked
options.mitigation: The chevron shows only while a cut on that track is picked, and its tip says Expand the cut (Option E).

options.label: The existing arrow opens the picked cut
options.summary: The arrow already on the header opens the cut into its A and B rows whenever a cut on that track is picked, and opens keyed values the rest of the time.
pros: One control on the header, as the mock draws one
cons: The same arrow does two different things depending on what is picked
options.mitigation: Its tip changes with what it will open.

options.label: No header control
options.summary: Keep the cut opening from its right-click, Clip menu and Option E only. Nothing is added to the track header.
pros: The header stays as it is
options.mitigation: The right-click on the cut and Option E already open it.
